findings.title: Nobody reads notifications
findings.message: Customer Communication Preferences Synchronisation Service publishes to notifications, but nothing consumes it: it keeps every message, unread.

fix.label: Add a consumer…
fix.needsChoice: Pick what reads notifications, then add it and connect long-sub to it.
